description: This file defines the DataSeriesValues class, which is part of the PHPSpreadsheet library used for handling chart data series within spreadsheets. It manages properties such as data type, data source formulas, formatting, colors, markers, and chart-specific options. It also includes methods for setting and retrieving these properties, as well as functionality for refreshing data from formulas and handling various data series configurations.

classes.name: DataSeriesValues
classes.description: Represents a data series in a chart, encapsulating properties such as data type, data source, formatting, colors, and data values, along with methods for managing and updating these properties.

methods.name: getDataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the series, e.g., 'String' or 'Number'.

methods.name: setDataType
methods.description: Sets the data type of the series, validating that it is either 'String' or 'Number'.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Retrieves the formula source for the data series.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the formula source for the data series.

methods.name: getPointMarker
methods.description: Retrieves the marker symbol used for data points.

methods.name: setPointMarker
methods.description: Sets the marker symbol for data points.

methods.name: getMarkerFillColor
methods.description: Gets the fill color object for the marker.

methods.name: getMarkerBorderColor
methods.description: Gets the border color object for the marker.

methods.name: getPointSize
methods.description: Returns the size of data points.

methods.name: setPointSize
methods.description: Sets the size of data points.

methods.name: getFormatCode
methods.description: Retrieves the format code applied to the series.

methods.name: setFormatCode
methods.description: Sets the format code for the series.

methods.name: getPointCount
methods.description: Returns the number of data points in the series.

methods.name: getFillColorObject
methods.description: Returns the fill color object, if any.

methods.name: getFillColor
methods.description: Returns the fill color(s) as HEX string(s).

methods.name: setFillColor
methods.description: Sets the fill color(s) for the series, accepting HEX strings, ChartColor objects, or arrays.

methods.name: validateColor
methods.description: Validates that a given string is a valid hex color code.

methods.name: getLineWidth
methods.description: Retrieves the line width for the series line style.

methods.name: setLineWidth
methods.description: Sets the line width for the series line style.

methods.name: isMultiLevelSeries
methods.description: Checks if the data series is multi-level (array of arrays).

methods.name: multiLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of levels in a multi-level data series.

methods.name: getDataValues
methods.description: Retrieves the data values.

methods.name: getDataValue
methods.description: Returns the primary data value, handling single or multiple data points.

methods.name: setDataValues
methods.description: Sets the data values, flattening arrays and updating point count.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates data values from the formula data source, recalculating and flattening as needed.

methods.name: getScatterLines
methods.description: Returns whether scatter lines are enabled.

methods.name: setScatterLines
methods.description: Enables or disables scatter lines.

methods.name: getBubble3D
methods.description: Returns whether 3D bubble chart styling is enabled.

methods.name: setBubble3D
methods.description: Enables or disables 3D bubble styling.

methods.name: getSmoothLine
methods.description: Returns whether the data series line is smooth.

methods.name: setSmoothLine
methods.description: Sets whether the data series line should be smooth.

methods.name: getLabelLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the label layout object, if any.

methods.name: setLabelLayout
methods.description: Sets the label layout object.

methods.name: setTrendLines
methods.description: Sets an array of trend lines associated with the data series.

methods.name: getTrendLines
methods.description: Retrieves the array of trend lines.
